# Third-party assets

All files in this folder were added from open-licensed projects. Licence texts are in `licenses/`.
Modifications: icons were cropped, background-keyed to transparency and scaled (nearest) to 32x32; audio files were copied unchanged and renamed.

## Sources

- Art by Dan Allen — CC-BY 4.0 — https://github.com/dsallen7/ransack-python (artwork only; that project's name and fonts are not used). Licence: `licenses/ransack-python.txt`
- Titan Tactics (Team Potato and contributors) — assets CC-BY 4.0, code CC0 — https://gitlab.com/team-potato/titan_tactics. 2D graphics: Romaselli, Federico Calchera; Music/SFX: Ondjon, Kssio. Licence: `licenses/titan_tactics.txt`, `licenses/titan_tactics-CREDITS.md`
- Godot Third Person Shooter Demo — assets CC-BY 3.0 (Juan Linietsky, Fernando Miguel Calabró), music CC-BY 3.0 (Christian Fernando Perucchi), code MIT — https://github.com/godotengine/tps-demo. Licence: `licenses/tps-demo.txt`
